Full summary: Lane 02b review fixes committed 0290566: lossy merges rolled back with a sticky push gate, carrier-decided publish idempotence, credential redaction, rejected-parent termination, append cost flat in corpus size. All five lanes review-fixed and committed; merge into foundation/v3 is next.
Decisions: Accepted lane 02b's partial refutations: redaction of remote credentials happens at construction (the id is committed into cursors, so print-time redaction is too late); cross-replica add/add conflicts are resolved keep-ours-and-retain-theirs (never checkout --ours, which loses a side); same-digest/different-signature duplicates are decided by which signature verifies (no timing input), not by a widened journal primary key that would break existing rows.
Findings: Append cost root cause: append() → validateOptions() → admittedView() read every admitted event file and ran the whole reducer on every write (O(n) per append, O(n²) per corpus). Memoized on COUNT+MAX(id) over admitted rows with explicit invalidation where admitted bytes change (purge, signature swap, rebuild). Measured: 16k p50 28.5→9.9 ms, p95 50.8→31.6 ms; last-decile p95 flat (10.7–10.9 ms) at both 8k and 16k; residual ~10 ms is ed25519 signing + two fsyncs. Lane 05's 35k threshold should be re-measured, not assumed gone.; At merge: add exchange/ to GITIGNORE_ENTRIES in src/storage/init.ts (canonical fix for stores that track .twining); the lane's .git/info/exclude write is belt-and-braces for pre-existing stores.
